hooks.command: k=$(printf %s "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_STREAM_ESTATE_API_KEY" | tr -d '[:space:]'); f="$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA/stream-estate-key"; case "$k" in ''|*[!A-Za-z0-9_.-]*) rm -f "$f" ;; *) mkdir -p "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA" && (umask 077; printf %s "$k" > "$f") && [ -n "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ] && printf 'export STREAM_ESTATE_API_KEY="$(cat %s)"\n' "'$f'" >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ;; esac; exit 0
